chapters.title: Search the house
chapters.summary: Scans the room, finds the three cans, and drives to the nearest orange one.

chapters.title: First grasp misses
chapters.summary: Measures the can, lowers the open right hand, closes, and test-lifts. The controller says the lift finished, but the wrist camera shows the can still on the floor.

chapters.title: Rethink the posture
chapters.summary: Reopens, checks its own posture, computes and previews a small torso lowering, applies it in two steps, grasps again, and confirms the can comes up.

chapters.title: Deliver can 1
chapters.summary: Turns to find the bin while holding the can, drives to it, measures the rim, centers the can over the opening, and lets go.

chapters.title: Deliver can 2
chapters.summary: Finds the second orange can by the sofa, lowers the torso again before grasping, carries it to the bin, and releases it.

chapters.title: Find the blue can and finish
chapters.summary: Turns to search again, finds the blue can by the table, grasps it after another torso adjustment, carries it back, measures the bin, and releases it.
